svg.title: An annotated synthetic live packet
svg.desc: Nineteen-byte example with frame header, status flags, SpO2 98 percent, pulse 72 bpm, PVI 20 percent, PI 5.5 percent, RRp 16 per minute, and an independently encoded CRC-8.
